solicitationExcerpt: The Contractor shall provide managed cybersecurity services for a term of three years with two one-year options. Offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at the time of proposal submission. The resulting contract is subject to FAR 52.212-4 and the agency's standard commercial terms. Required deliverables include a monthly status report, an incident response plan, and a quarterly penetration test summary. Questions regarding this solicitation are due fourteen days after release; proposals are due thirty days after release. Offerors must include evidence of past performance on at least two similar engagements.
